name: platform-availability
title: Platform availability
description: Where it runs: web, iOS, Android, desktop and API as tiles with status, version and a link to get it.
docs: Pass title, an optional description, platforms and a footnote. Each platform has an id, a label, an icon, a status ("available", "beta" or "soon"), an optional version and releasedAt (an ISO date, written in the locale and timeZone you pass), an href with a linkLabel ("Open the app", "App Store", "Download") and a note. The status is a pill with its word and a shape, never colour alone. A tile with a link is a whole-tile link named after its platform. A coming-soon tile has no download: pass an href and it becomes a plain link to a waiting list ("Tell me when it is ready" unless you give a linkLabel). The tiles are a list, so a screen reader hears how many there are. Edit the data and the page stays honest; visitors stop asking whether there is an Android app. labels translates the status words and the fixed text.
